charge_correction.name: charge_correction
charge_correction.value:
("charge"."kind" = 'correction') = ("charge"."correction_kind" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("charge"."correction_kind" IS NULL OR "charge"."correction_kind" IN ('units', 'dollars', 'pricing'))

mgmt_user_kind_email_check.name: mgmt_user_kind_email_check
mgmt_user_kind_email_check.value: ("mgmt_user"."kind" = 'human' and "mgmt_user"."email" is not null) or ("mgmt_user"."kind" = 'service' and "mgmt_user"."email" is null)
